## Details

<a id="ai_attack_facing_table"></a>
### [`ai_attack_facing_table`](../../../../src/ai/ai_tables.asm#L6) `$26D5-$2724`

*data*

Attack choice when the fighters have different facings. Index = distance + $33 + random spread: $08-$32 opponent behind, $33-$47 in front. Values are move commands. Entries 0-7 and $4f are never read.

- **Read by:** [`ai_update`](ai_opponent.md#ai_update)

<a id="ai_attack_same_facing_table"></a>
### [`ai_attack_same_facing_table`](../../../../src/ai/ai_tables.asm#L18) `$2725-$2773`

*data*

Attack choice when both fighters have the same facing. Index = distance + $29 + random spread: $08-$28 opponent in front, $29-$47 behind. Entries 0-7 are never read.

- **Read by:** [`ai_update`](ai_opponent.md#ai_update)

<a id="ai_special_jump_table"></a>
### [`ai_special_jump_table`](../../../../src/ai/ai_tables.asm#L30) `$2774-$2787`

*data*

Addresses of the special actions 1-9; entry 0 ($0000) is never used. Read at $268b and $2690.

- **Read by:** [`ai_dispatch_special`](ai_opponent_2521.md#ai_dispatch_special)

<a id="ai_special_by_move"></a>
### [`ai_special_by_move`](../../../../src/ai/ai_tables.asm#L35) `$2788-$27A0`

*data*

Special action (1-9, 0 = none) against each opponent move $00-$18. Move $0e, the flying kick, gets special action 9.

- **Read by:** [`ai_update`](ai_opponent.md#ai_update)

<a id="ai_reply_to_low_block"></a>
### [`ai_reply_to_low_block`](../../../../src/ai/ai_tables.asm#L41) `$27A1-$27A4`

*data*

Four attacks against an opponent in low block $13: moves the block does not stop.

- **Read by:** [`ai_update`](ai_opponent.md#ai_update)

<a id="ai_reply_to_high_block"></a>
### [`ai_reply_to_high_block`](../../../../src/ai/ai_tables.asm#L44) `$27A5-$27A8`

*data*

Four attacks against an opponent in high block $14: moves the block does not stop.

- **Read by:** [`ai_update`](ai_opponent.md#ai_update)

<a id="ai_level_hold_mask"></a>
### [`ai_level_hold_mask`](../../../../src/ai/ai_tables.asm#L47) `$27A9-$27B4`

*data*

Skill level tables, levels 0-11: hold mask and release time, attack spread, attack delay, walk, stop, variant, response and reaction masks. ai_setup_level reads them by cpu_skill.

- **Read by:** [`ai_setup_level`](ai_opponent_2521.md#ai_setup_level)

<a id="ai_level_spread_mask"></a>
### [`ai_level_spread_mask`](../../../../src/ai/ai_tables.asm#L50) `$27B5-$27C0`

*data*

- **Read by:** [`ai_setup_level`](ai_opponent_2521.md#ai_setup_level)

<a id="ai_level_attack_mask"></a>
### [`ai_level_attack_mask`](../../../../src/ai/ai_tables.asm#L54) `$27C1-$27CC`

*data*

Attack delay masks. Levels 6-11 differ from version I: $7f, $1f, $07, $0f, $3f, $1f.

- **Read by:** [`ai_setup_level`](ai_opponent_2521.md#ai_setup_level)

<a id="ai_level_walk_mask"></a>
### [`ai_level_walk_mask`](../../../../src/ai/ai_tables.asm#L58) `$27CD-$27D7`

*data*

Only 11 entries: level 11 reads the first stop mask at $27d8.

- **Read by:** [`ai_setup_level`](ai_opponent_2521.md#ai_setup_level)

<a id="ai_level_stop_mask"></a>
### [`ai_level_stop_mask`](../../../../src/ai/ai_tables.asm#L62) `$27D8-$27E3`

*data*

Stop masks. Levels 8-11 stop again while they walk ($0f, $07, $1f, $0f).

- **Read by:** [`ai_setup_level`](ai_opponent_2521.md#ai_setup_level)

<a id="ai_level_variant_mask"></a>
### [`ai_level_variant_mask`](../../../../src/ai/ai_tables.asm#L65) `$27E4-$27EF`

<a id="ai_level_response_mask"></a>
### [`ai_level_response_mask`](../../../../src/ai/ai_tables.asm#L69) `$27F0-$27FB`

*data*

Response masks: bit 7 attack, bits 4-6 block or jump, bits 0-3 special action, no bit a random move.

- **Read by:** [`ai_setup_level`](ai_opponent_2521.md#ai_setup_level)
